raw_text: Insider sources at ISRO confirm the cyber attack was more serious than officially acknowledged. The spear-phishing emails contained zero-day exploits targeting the email client used internally. At least three workstations in the telemetry division were compromised before the attack was contained. Mission control systems on the air-gapped network were not affected.
clean_text: ISRO insider claims cyber attack more serious than acknowledged. Zero-day exploits in phishing emails compromised three telemetry workstations. Air-gapped mission control unaffected.
